description: Shrink HTML by removing comments and collapsing whitespace, with byte stats showing how much was saved.

faqs.a: It strips HTML comments (except conditional comments), collapses runs of whitespace, and removes whitespace between tags. The contents of <pre>, <textarea>, <script> and <style> blocks are preserved exactly.
Yes — whitespace inside <pre>, <textarea>, <script> and <style> is left untouched so rendering and code behavior stay the same.
faqs.q: Is whitespace inside pre and script tags preserved?

faqs.a: No. All minification happens locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Paste your HTML into the input box.
Check the original vs minified byte stats and the percentage saved.
Copy the result or download it as an .html file.
title: HTML Minifier
